item.title: The Wellness Rundown: HSCA, protecting our senior family members
item.description: In the latest episode of the Wellness Rundown, KAMR Local 4’s Mari Ferrel sat down with Mark Aldrich from Hometown Senior Care Advisors to talk about ways to keep our senior family members safe.

item.title: Former police officer in Oklahoma arrested
item.description: The Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigations reported that a former police officer in Oklahoma was arrested following an investigation into allegations of embezzlement and perjury.

item.title: West Plains Soccer battles through tough district ahead of playoffs
item.description: With two district games remaining, the West Plains High School girls' soccer team is looking to finish strong and carry momentum into the playoffs. Head coach Amberly Gerald said entering the season, she knew the Lady Wolves had versatile, multi-positional talent and leaned into that strength throughout the year.

item.title: Abbott announces state resources ready ahead of predicted severe weather
item.description: Governor Greg Abbott announced that the Texas Division of Emergency Management was activated ahead of projected threats of severe weather across the state.

item.description: Holly Jeffreys has been announced as the projected winner for the Primary Election Republican State Representative, District 86, and will be on the November ballot.

item.title: Local Remarkable Women 2026 winner: Jae Casias, a volunteering spirit
item.description: Jae Casias is one of many volunteers for Amarillo’s Local Outreach to Suicide Survivors or L.O.S.S. Team. Amarillo unfortunately has a suicide rate that’s higher than the national average, and Jae said when she started to volunteer she “wanted to help people not feel the way that I felt”.

item.title: Election results on the High Plains: March 3, 2026 primary elections
item.description: Communities around the Texas Panhandle and High Plains are set to make their voices heard on March 3 by voting on federal, statewide and local candidate primaries, as well as other ballot questions.
